message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. MFA for admins blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so neither admin_dc nor admin_adfs can become true. MFA for database admins then blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, even if CI leaks database-admin credentials. Thus no exfiltration technique is reachable. No single control suffices: segmentation can be bypassed by escalating a phished workstation; any single patch or mfa:user leaves the credential-based DC route open; mfa:dbadmin is bypassed through DC or ADFS administration; and mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-secret route open."}
